why: A is exists_localDetChart (universes 0): every Fredholm T is the centre of a LocalDetChart. B's admissible triples IsDetChart T P ε are exactly the (c.T, c.P, c.ε) of the project's charts (chartOf/hcOf; Y is existential in B), so B (1) ⇔ A, and B_to_A uses B (1). B (2), that γ_(T,P,ε) is a bijection from DET(E,F) over the ball onto DET(T,P,ε) for EVERY admissible triple, does not follow from A; A_to_B proves it outright (gammaChart_bijective). Fibrewise γ is gammaProj, a linear equivalence, but surjectivity needs every S of the ball to be Fredholm (chart_isFredholm: ker S ⊆ ker PS; S(Y) is closed because P is a left inverse of S∘(PS|_Y)⁻¹; F = R(S) + ker P). The project never states this: its pretriv, which is γ read in the frame ω (gammaChart_eq), is a pretrivialization only over c.baseSet, the Fredholm part of the ball. So B carries a true claim that A lacks (about 60 lines here), and nothing in A is missing from B.
